rules.action: Treat meta as price-crawler progress and metadata as current security/fundamental attributes.

rules.rule: Numeric -1 means queried but no numeric value.
rules.action: Convert to missing/NaN for analysis; do not use as a real negative value.
Use field-specific missing_rule; distinguish not collected, unavailable and clean status.
Parse exact normalized strings; never apply generic truthiness to non-empty strings.

rules.rule: Empty margin_status means clean/no flagged status.
rules.action: Do not label empty values as unknown risk unless source context contradicts this convention.

rules.rule: Snapshots may include dead or stale tickers.
rules.action: For live analysis filter to the latest market date and inspect exchange/status; ASA is a known stale example.
Label as estimate and avoid presenting it as official free float.

rules.rule: Shareholder data is point-in-time with no history.
rules.action: Do not use current ownership snapshot in historical backtests or infer historical holdings.

rules.rule: Prices may not be fully adjusted for dividends or splits.
rules.action: Flag long-horizon returns and MA breaks around corporate actions; verify adjustment before backtesting.
Read and write explicitly as UTF-8; preserve Vietnamese text.

rules.rule: VCI and KBS may return percentage values on different scales (0..1 versus 0..100).
rules.action: Use normalized processed values or validate provider scale before combining raw observations.

rules.rule: Raw BCTC and financial_snapshot have different shapes and grain.
rules.action: Raw has item rows and period columns; processed snapshot has ticker-period rows and standardized measure columns. Never concatenate them directly.

rules.rule: Current snapshots are not historical dimensions.
Change semantics depend on series unit.
rules.action: For percent series interpret as percentage-point difference; otherwise as percent change.

rules.rule: News has no canonical ticker field.
rules.action: Do not assert ticker linkage without a validated entity-linking step.

rules.rule: Quant and AI reports are derived outputs.
rules.action: Use them as context, not ground truth; verify important claims against source datasets.
